selected_upstream_sequence: interpolate physical channel 191 and include it in Kilosort
required_sidecar: Preserve raw over-500-uV sample/channel intervals and exclude nearby sorter detections from artifact-sensitive claims; do not treat blank-induced peaks as neural.
known_cost: The 500-uV samplewise blanker can create local ringing/false peaks and worsens event density in saturation-enriched seconds. It is retained because removing it causes much larger sorter-level reviewed-neural recovery losses.

positive_polarity_excess.return_to: Measure the same raw-voltage polarity and over-500-uV rates in multiple Luke sessions, both imec streams, Yates controls, and another acquisition rig.
positive_polarity_excess.decision_use_now: Do not use positive-polarity event density for biological claims and retain the artifact sidecar exclusion.

advancement: Conditioning is fixed provisionally. Continue only with motion disabled until a matched no-motion baseline using this exact sequence is established.
